newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Jobs, inflation both important - RBA's Fraser.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Jobs, inflation both important - RBA's Fraser.

text.p: Reserve Bank of Australia Governor (RBA) Bernie Fraser said on Thursday central banks should not lose sight of employment and growth in achieving their inflation goals, or they could lose community support.
In response to a question after he gave a speech at a BZW Australia Day seminar in Tokyo, Fraser said reducing unemployment and keeping inflation low were both important.

"At the Reserve Bank we have a formal requirement to be concerned about unemployment and growth as well as with inflation...which makes the Reserve Bank charter a bit different from that of most other central banks where there's usually a
focus these days just on inflation, " Fraser said.
His comments were broadcast by Reuters Financial Television (RFTV).
Fraser, who retires on September 17, said he had always been comfortable with that multiple objective, and he said other central banks should consider employment and growth as well.

"I think central banks need to be concerned about growth and employment as well as inflation, and I suspect that if they're not, if they're not able to deliver some progress on unemployment that will lose support, lose community support, for the low inflation objective," he said.
